pages.text: $(li)$(l)Night Lich$(): in the cold. Undead drop $(l:bosses/bomd#soul_star)Soul Stars$(/l) that fly toward its tower. Four of them call it down.$(li)$(l)Nether Gauntlet$(): in a rare structure in the Nether.
$(li)$(l)Void Blossom$(): at the very bottom of the world. Void lilies point the way.$(li)$(l)Obsidilith$(): in a rare structure out on the End islands.
Throw it and follow it to the Night Lich's tower.
